title: b7z9.47(b): CI clang-tidy full coverage via compile_commands.json
description: Sibling child of worker6-b7z9.47(a) (R-APPC-010). CI (.github/workflows/ci.yml:130-136) runs clang-tidy on 'find ... | head -50' with -p /dev/null — arbitrary 50-file coverage and no compile database, so Zephyr-heavy files produce include errors instead of real findings. Fix: generate compile_commands.json in CI (CMake ZEPHYR_EXPORT_COMPILE_COMMANDS or a bearer/cmake pass over the standalone test dirs; Zephyr files need the west/Zephyr env — consider scoping to a curated per-directory compile DB or a twister step that exports it), then run clang-tidy over the COMPLETE subsys/lib/drivers file list with that DB. Verify: job green, coverage count reported, no include-error noise. Landable only after (a).
